newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kirin Brewery falls on lower market share.
newsitem.headline: Kirin Brewery falls on lower market share.

text.p: Shares of Kirin Brewery Co Ltd sharply fell on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning as part of selling of some blue chips and due to its falling market share, brokers said.
By 0120 GMT, Kirin was down 90 yen at 1,010 yen. It was the third-largest percentage loser on the first section of the TSE.
"Some institutional investors are selling shares of some blue-chip issues," said an official of a mid-sized securities house.
He said that besides the fall in Kirin shares, a drop in the prices of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd and some other blue-chip issues was worrisome.
Matsushita shares were down 70 at 1,720 yen by 0121 GMT.

An official of a major brokerage said of Kirin: "According to beer-makers' data, it is now apparent that Asahi Breweries Ltd is taking market share from Kirin and that is partly a reason why Kirin shares are being sold."
